video: Daniel e a cova dos leões
descricao: Sombras de homens à beira da cova ao amanhecer (laço aberto: 'outros homens' que nem tocaram o chão).
prompt_en: Atmospheric wide shot of the edge of the great round stone pit at dawn, several dark human silhouettes seen from behind and far away standing at the rim and tumbling over the edge into the pit, only shadows and motion blur with no detail and nothing graphic, a few pairs of glowing amber lion eyes in the darkness below, cold blue pre-dawn light with a thin line of gold on the horizon, dust rising, ominous and shocking, composition centered with the pit in the lower two thirds. Cinematic photorealistic film still, shot on 35mm anamorphic lens, Rembrandt chiaroscuro, volumetric light with haze and floating dust, shallow depth of field, rich teal-black shadows and warm amber-gold highlights, fine film grain, ultra-detailed textures of stone, cloth and skin, 8k, masterpiece, ancient Babylon and Persia around 540 BC, reverent tense mood

personagens.daniel: DANIEL: elderly man, short grey beard, simple off-white linen tunic with a dark blue-grey wool mantle, bare feet or plain leather sandals; seen only from behind, in profile or in silhouette, never facing the camera.
personagens.rei: KING DARIUS: Median king, deep purple robe with gold trim, tall rounded gold tiara, heavy gold ring on his hand; seen only from behind, in profile or in silhouette.
